paragraphs: When I onboard a client, there are a lot of details I need to keep track of from contact details to the project rate.

banners.title: Build your client list
paragraphs: Quit losing clients in your inbox and have a reliable client relationship management system to track them with your ongoing work together. Create unique clients profiles with all your notes, contacts, rates and tags.

banners.title: Keep it together
paragraphs: Organize all the todos, files and documents for your projects. Your clients even get their own project view to manage payments and contracts you’ve sent.

banners.title: Work with others
paragraphs: Whether they’re a subcontractor or a co-worker, you can freely collaborate on projects with other users to assign them tasks and track time together. Our built-in project collaboration tools make working together a seamless experience.

tiles.title: Time tracking
tiles.text: Keep track of the hours you work every day, on every project and on every device. Add notes and the task completed with each new entry.

tiles.title: Task management
tiles.text: Use simple task lists and create task templates on your projects to see what needs to be done. Set due dates and get email reminders.

faq.question: Does Bonsai offer lead generation automation?

paragraphs.text: integration included in your account, you have the ability to automate leads, manage your client relationships, track project progress and much more with just a few clicks.

faq.question: Can I qualify leads with Bonsai CRM?

paragraphs.text: Sure! With Bonsai’s custom tagging you have the ability to use your own lead scoring methodology and organize your lead prospects based on how likely they are to turn from prospects to paying customers.

faq.question: Who is Bonsai CRM Best For?

paragraphs.text: Bonsai CRM is great for all businesses looking to deploy a client management solution that includes a CRM with client portal.
, architects, lawyers, and accountants are just several of the businesses that use our CRM every day for managing clients and projects.
